root_cause.error: The sole upstream resolution returned a commit absent from every local Git object store.
root_cause.contract_conflict: The preflight permits exactly two network commands and uses the second only for git ls-remote, while the production build forbids network. Therefore a newly resolved upstream object cannot be acquired without an unauthorized third network command.

disposition: Method v1.3 cannot proceed or be scored. No production build was invoked. A later protocol version must make the sole upstream network operation both resolve and materialize the exact commit before its fresh P0 and S0.
